hypothesis: Adding the shared FF2 projection, bias, and residual join to the exact LibNC tail recreates the full optimized graph contract and reproduces the receipt-bound ff2_0 and ff_bias2_0 gradients that the isolated tail and matched PyTorch composition miss.
interfaces_exposed: Exact attn_out plus ff2_in states -> shared FF2 projection and bias -> exact decoder tail -> named ff2 and bias gradients
kill_condition: Stop on source, tensor, probe, or probability identity failure; if the direct LibNC block misses either named bound gradient, retire FF2-to-loss composition as sufficient and move the boundary earlier without changing a proved forward primitive.
promotion_condition: Authorize one faithful FF2-to-loss replay child only if two archive-identical source captures and two byte-identical direct block probes reproduce teacher probabilities and both bound ff2_0 and ff_bias2_0 gradients within 2e-6 with identical signs while the matched PyTorch block misses.
rejection_reason: Exact source, tensor, probe, and probability identities passed. Direct LibNC matched PyTorch within 4.47e-8 on ff2 and 7.45e-8 on bias, but both retained the source-bound gradient misses. Retire FF2-to-loss composition and test joint concat-optimization root scope.
retired_neighborhoods: Isolated decoder tail; positional gradient inference; output projection and loss primitives.
title: NNCP v3.3 LibNC FF2-to-loss backward composition
